name: DTMAPI 更多存档
author: Yuuka
description: 依赖 DTMAPI Runtime。扩展官方存档界面槽位，不改存档格式，禁用不删除额外存档，基于 DTMAPI SaveSlots API。

localized_description.schinese: 依赖 DTMAPI Runtime。扩展官方存档界面显示的本地存档槽数量，不改存档格式。前六个槽位保持原版兼容；禁用后不会删除额外存档文件。基于 DTMAPI SaveSlots API。
localized_description.tchinese: 依賴 DTMAPI Runtime。擴展官方存檔介面顯示的本地存檔槽數量，不改存檔格式。前六個槽位保持原版相容；停用後不會刪除額外存檔檔案。基於 DTMAPI SaveSlots API。
localized_description.english: Requires DTMAPI Runtime. Expands the number of local save slots shown by the official save UI without changing the save format. The first six slots remain vanilla-compatible, and disabling the mod does not delete extra archive files. Built on the DTMAPI SaveSlots API.
